stem: After a candidate is registered on the OPTN waiting list, when must the transplant hospital send the required written patient notification?

options.text: Within 10 business days, including the registration date
Only after the candidate receives a transplant offer
Within 90 days after the five-year transplant anniversary
Never; verbal notification is sufficient without documentation

explanation.rationale_correct: OPTN Policy 3.5 requires transplant hospitals to notify patients in writing within 10 business days when they are registered on the waiting list, including the registration date.

rationale_incorrect.B: Written notification is required at waitlist registration, not deferred until an organ offer.
rationale_incorrect.C: Ninety-day anniversary timing applies to follow-up data forms, not initial waitlist registration notification.
rationale_incorrect.D: Policy 3.5 requires documented written notification, not verbal notification alone.

primary_anchor.quote_hint: within 10 business days … registered on the waiting list … date the patient was registered

references.locator: Policy 3.5 → Table 3-2: Transplant Hospital Patient Notification Requirements (written notification within 10 business days of waitlist registration); PDF p. 46 (repo file-page index; printed margin may differ).

notes: Source-first item. Fifth 020400 item; OPTN registration-notification angle distinct from approval/not-listed/MELD-change communications; anchor verified on optn-policies p. 46.

stem: A lung waitlist candidate is hospitalized at a community hospital for pneumonia. What is the coordinator's appropriate communication expectation for the patient?

options.text: Notify the transplant team of changes in health status, including outside hospital admissions
Withhold all health updates until the next annual clinic visit
Report admissions only if they occur at the transplant center hospital
Remove the patient from the waitlist automatically without team review

explanation.rationale_correct: Waitlist management includes patient responsibility to notify the transplant team of changes in health status, including admissions to hospitals other than the transplant center.

rationale_incorrect.B: Health status changes should be reported promptly, not deferred to annual visits.
rationale_incorrect.C: Patients must notify the team about outside hospital admissions as well as transplant-center care.
rationale_incorrect.D: Outside admissions trigger team notification and assessment rather than automatic delisting.

primary_anchor.section: Ch. 3, Patient Education → §9. Waitlist management → b.i.
primary_anchor.quote_hint: Notify the transplant team of any changes in their Health status (including admissions to hospitals other than the transplant center)

references.citation: Core Curriculum for Transplant Nurses, 2nd ed. (Cupples et al., 2016).
references.locator: Ch. 3 → §9. Waitlist management → b.i. (notify team of health status changes including outside admissions); PDF p. 101 (repo file-page index; printed margin may differ).

notes: Source-first item. Sixth 020400 item; lung waitlist health-status reporting distinct from OPTN registration notice (cctc-2041) and MELD-change education (cctc-2018); anchor verified on Cupples p. 101.

stem: When coordinating pulmonary evaluation testing for a lung transplant candidate, which invasive study may be included in the transplant evaluation protocol?

explanation.rationale_correct: Transplant evaluation pulmonary testing may include pulmonary function tests, bronchoscopy, and arterial blood gas among organ-specific diagnostic protocols.

rationale_incorrect.B: Cosmetic dermatology biopsy is not a standard pulmonary transplant evaluation study.
rationale_incorrect.C: Appendectomy without indication is not part of standard pulmonary evaluation protocols.
rationale_incorrect.D: Human transplant evaluation does not include veterinary assessment.

stem: A liver waitlist candidate is being removed from the waiting list after transplantation at another center. What OPTN-required data must be available to process the removal?

options.text: Current MELD or PELD score calculation data
Only the donor family's contact preferences
The recipient's unrelated prior employment history
No data are required for any liver waitlist removal

explanation.rationale_correct: For liver candidates, the data necessary to calculate the candidate's current MELD or PELD score is required to remove the candidate from the waiting list.

rationale_incorrect.B: Donor family contact preferences are not the OPTN-required dataset for liver waitlist removal.
rationale_incorrect.C: Employment history is not the required OPTN data element for liver waitlist removal.
rationale_incorrect.D: OPTN Policy 3.9.A requires current MELD or PELD calculation data for liver waitlist removal.

primary_anchor.section: Policy 3.9.A → Removing Liver Candidates from the Waiting List
